scope: Refresh open-source DWG/DXF/ACIS peer evidence by operation, release, carrier, owner, writer, reopen, and semantic boundary; update existing plan gates only.

method.sourceClass: project-owned release notes, source documentation, issues, and pull requests

observations: v3.6.51 release notes include ACIS payload reading for 3DSOLID, REGION, and BODY via PR #1139, and Prototype1b parsing via PR #1154.
The latest tagged release page at review time is v3.8.0; current master remains a separate, moving candidate.
Open issue #1195 reports silent DWG-to-DXF loss using ACadSharp 3.4.9 and links to open writer PR #1240.
PR #1240 depends on open schema refactor #1174 and has no deployment; open contributor PR #1150 is not shipped behavior.
Peer branch discussion identifies repeated group-310 retention, sorted-handle rank/index, SAT group-1/3 token framing, and versioned DXF subclass markers as test dimensions, not normative sources.
sources.disposition: Release-pinned optional structural peer; no writer parity or semantic support claim inferred.

observations: Supports ASCII/Binary DXF read/write through R2018 and retention of third-party content.
ACIS browser exposes raw SAT/SAB carrier data; ACIS payload creation requires an external library.
The drawing add-on does not render ACIS and has no 3D rendering engine.
sources.disposition: DXF structure/raw-carrier observer only; not a B-rep oracle.

observations: The shared model preserves raw records/source spans and validates reference closure, while its documentation explicitly distinguishes that from B-rep validity or product-version compatibility.
The documented decoder covers bounded SAB/ASM profiles; container extraction is separate and SAT serialization is not covered.
This is associated with the existing cq-acis route and is not an independent second parser/kernel vote.
sources.disposition: Optional parser/model architecture evidence only; no dependency or support promotion.

implementationReadyChecks: At the scheduled composed peer checkpoint, bind one immutable release or commit per operation and direction.
Track source entity handle, type, block/owner path, payload digest, writer diagnostic, emitted record, strict-reopen identity, and consumer disposition.
Use a locally generated scratch-only solid-only block control so silent omission is observable without downloading customer drawings.
Report wire preservation, graph/reference closure, and geometry-kernel validity/topology/metrics as separate conclusions.
Do not run peer or native application checks in each fast implementation slice; if an upstream writer remains unreleased, report that lane unavailable and continue local work.
doesNotEstablish: that open ACadSharp PRs are correct, merged, deployed, or interoperable
that retained raw ACIS bytes or closed references form a valid B-rep
independent ACIS/ACDS semantic evidence or promotion of J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, or J295
